completion_data.completion_summary: Delegated literature-audit.sh's DEFAULT_SEARCH_PATHS storage root and zotero-setup.sh's _detect_data_dir() Step 3 to the canonical zotero-resolve-sqlite-path.sh resolver, replacing two private hardcoded candidate ladders. Reworded the cmd_detect stderr diagnostic to describe the delegated ladder truthfully. Verified live via a three-way agreement check (resolver, --detect, and the audit search path all now resolve to the same live ~/Documents/Zotero directory instead of the stale, empty ~/Zotero) and a real literature-audit.sh --xref run whose 5 test PDFs were confirmed to come from the resolver-derived storage path.

memory_candidates.content: When delegating multiple callers to a shared resolver script, verify the fix live (not just via diff) by asserting three-way agreement between the resolver's raw output and each caller's derived value, and by running at least one caller end-to-end to confirm it actually reaches the resolver-derived path rather than an earlier fallback in its own search order.
